subject: SIG evidence request: SDLC controls (code review, CI/CD, secrets)
messages:
From: Rachel Li <rachel.li@finserv-inc.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@acme-assess.com
Date: 2026-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG evidence request: SDLC controls for upcoming assessment

Hi Aisha / Ben,

We’re starting the SIG assessment for FinServ Inc and need a compact evidence package covering your Secure SDLC. Can you provide the following by EOD 2026-09-15?

- Code review policy + one month of sample PRs (redacted as necessary) showing approvals and reviewer identities
- CI/CD gating config and a recent build pipeline run (showing branch protection, required checks, and gated releases)
- Secrets management doc (vault usage, access controls, ephemeral tokens, rotation cadence)
- Change management logs for the past 90 days (author, approver, timestamp, rollback history)
- Any automated checks (SAST/Dependency scanning) and alerting integrations

If you can provide an index CSV mapping artifacts to SIG questions that’ll speed the assessor’s work. We’d prefer: CSV + three supporting artifacts (PDF/patch/log).

Thanks — let me know if any of the asks are unclear or need more time.

—Rachel
Rachel Li
Security Reviewer, FinServ Inc

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Li <rachel.li@finserv-inc.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-08T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request: SDLC controls for upcoming assessment

Hi Rachel — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver an evidence bundle by the deadline. Plan below (owners + delivery):

1) Index CSV (maps evidence -> SIG question): owner Aisha Rahman — deliver: sdlc-evidence-index.csv (by 2026-09-10)
2) Sample PRs: owner Ben Carter — three redacted PRs including one cross-repo dependency bump and one security patch; will include reviewer timestamps and approval signatures (pr-review-sample.patch)
3) CI/CD config + recent pipeline run: owner Markus Klein — export of pipeline policy + sanitized build logs; will include branch protection and required checks; PDF artifact: ci-pipeline-policy.pdf
4) Secrets management & KMS rotation schedule: owner Lauren Bishop (cc’d internally) — will provide vault policy excerpts and rotation cadence notes
5) Change management: we’ll attach a 90-day changelog extract and a short runbook describing revert procedures

Attachments: index CSV attached. We will supply the remaining artifacts as downloadable links to a secured Drive folder (link below) and a DocuSign attestation for the redacted PRs if the assessor needs provenance. If you need the logs in a specific format let us know.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-09T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: PR samples & provenance notes (for SIG)

Aisha / Lauren — I’m preparing the three PRs. Quick notes so we’re aligned with the assessor’s ask:

- PR 1 (security-fix): full diff redacted for customer data; include reviewer list and commit SHAs; show CI green status and required checks passing
- PR 2 (dependency bump): include SBOM scan result and SCA findings (no high severity in latest run)
- PR 3 (feature + migration): show merge approval timestamp and post-merge rollback entry (we had a hotfix rollback last month; will include the change history)

I’ll attach a small patch file (pr-review-sample.patch) with metadata and a brief provenance statement for each PR. For provenance we’ll include: author email, commit SHAs, CI run id, reviewer usernames, and policy check IDs.

One ask for Lauren / Markus: can we include the pipeline run id and the eks-job/node id that executed the job? Assessor sometimes traces the runtime id to the build log. If that’s sensitive we can redact specifics and include a signed attestation.

Cheers,
Ben
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform

Aisha / Ben / Lauren — sending a quick confirmation: the index CSV and the listed artifacts are sufficient for our initial review. A couple of clarifying items before we close the loop: 

- KMS rotation cadence: can you confirm the rotation schedule (monthly/quarterly) and whether you can provide a rotation proof (KMS audit event) for one rotation in the past 12 months?
- For PR provenance: redacted SHAs are OK; we’ll accept a signed attestation if you prefer to limit runtime identifiers.

If you can post the rest of the artifacts to the Drive folder linked below and drop the DocuSign attestation reference we’ll begin processing.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-sdlc-evidence
DocuSign reference: DS-84839-SIG
